note: NECO Literature-in-English Paper III round 1: literary appreciation across the syllabus - figures of speech (simile to metonymy), poetry forms and terms (sonnet, elegy, persona), drama (soliloquy, chorus, denouement), prose (narration, foil, flashback), general literary knowledge (diction, allegory, pathos) and African classics (Achebe, Soyinka, Adichie, Ngugi, p'Bitek, Nwapa, Emecheta, Rotimi, Blake, Shakespeare). Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
